cardinal-natural.description: Read plain cardinal numbers in their natural spoken form.

configured-uppercase-initialism.description: Read all-uppercase acronyms letter by letter when policy selects the initialism reading.

countdown-no-range-word.description: Read countdown digits in sequence without introducing range semantics.

currency-major-minor.description: Read major and minor currency units while preserving exact amount semantics.

date-natural.description: Read fully specified non-ambiguous dates in their natural spoken form for the active locale.

de-DE-dmY.description: Interpret numeric slash dates as day/month/year under de-DE policy.

en-US-mdY.description: Interpret numeric slash dates as month/day/year under en-US policy.

es-ES-dmY.description: Interpret numeric slash dates as day/month/year under es-ES policy.

identifier-spellout.description: Read mixed identifiers by preserving their distinguishing alphanumeric sequence.

ipv4-digitwise.description: Read IPv4 octets digitwise while preserving dot separators.

math-expression-operator.description: Read simple math operators explicitly without collapsing them into score or range semantics.

measurement-unit-natural.description: Read value-plus-unit expressions with natural unit names.

natural-decimal.description: Read decimal separator naturally while preserving exact fractional digits.

natural-fraction.description: Read common numeric fractions using natural fraction wording.

ordinal-natural.description: Read ordinal numbers using their natural spoken ordinal form.

require-locale-or-context.description: Do not force a single reading when context or locale does not disambiguate the form.

score-or-range-contextual.description: Read hyphenated score and numeric-range forms using context-preserving wording.

semantic-version.description: Read semantic version components in version order, including prerelease markers.

spell-initialism-preserve-plural.description: Spell an initialism letter by letter while preserving plural marking.

time-natural.description: Read times in a natural spoken form while preserving minute values.

unadjudicated-upstream.description: Placeholder policy for imported candidate data pending adjudication.

url-or-email-literal.description: Read URLs and email addresses as literal contact or locator strings.
